z|esc_como_1: Identity: each computer has its own Curve25519 and Ed25519 keys; verification is the short code (SAS) you compare. Identity signatures are Ed25519: they are not post-quantum.
z|esc_como_2: Messages: Olm (vodozemac's double ratchet, Matrix's) and on top a hybrid ML-KEM-768 layer (FIPS 203) with ChaCha20-Poly1305, renewed every 50 messages or 10 minutes.
z|esc_como_3: Files in the conversation: XChaCha20-Poly1305 with a fresh key per file, in numbered blocks; the key travels inside Olm and the ML-KEM layer.
z|esc_como_4: Calls: WebRTC with DTLS-SRTP and Opus; what sets them up goes inside Olm. The audio encryption (DTLS) is not post-quantum.
z|esc_como_5: Delivery room: the 256-bit key travels only in the link; ECDH P-256 + AES-256-GCM channel, and each file with its own AES-256-GCM key (STREAM) and its hash tree (RFC 6962). No ML-KEM: the receiver's browser does not have it.
z|esc_como_6: Sizes: what goes between computers is padded to fixed sizes (Padmé), so the relay cannot tell the length of each message. It does not hide when you talk.
z|esc_como_7: On your disk: the key of your identity and those of the deliveries, sealed with DPAPI for your Windows account. On macOS, readable by your user only.
z|esc_como_8: GUARDIANA stores no IP addresses and reads nothing: the relay only passes encrypted bytes.

z|ent_frase: Hand files of any kind and size (up to 1 TB each) to someone outside: a link that works once and a separate code. The receiver needs only a browser. The relay sees only encrypted data and, at the end, you both keep the same signed receipt.

z|ent_codigo_aparte: Pass it on by another road (a call, a different message). Three wrong codes destroy the delivery.

z|ent_motivo_dispositivo_nuevo: Destroyed: another browser tried to open it after the receiver
z|ent_como: Each file is sealed on your disk with its own AES-256-GCM key, in pieces of 1 MiB (STREAM). The link carries a 256-bit key your browser never sends; the receiver joins through the relay server with an ECDH P-256 + AES-256-GCM channel and, only after the right code, gets the keys. Each piece is verified on arrival and checked against the hash tree; a broken download resumes where it stopped. No IP address is stored.
z|ent_limite: This PC must stay on until the receiver finishes. What the receiver saves cannot be erased from here.
z|ent_sin_dpapi: This system has no DPAPI: the delivery keys stay in a file readable by your user only.
